title: Cyprus
text:
The island the tablets of the mainland call Alashiya. Its copper is one of the things the eastern Mediterranean cannot do without, and its harbors are where that copper meets the ships.

The island is not one kingdom. This harbor is one community: a yard, a smithy, an inn, and people who speak a language the traveler cannot follow.

sources: Alashiya in Late Bronze Age correspondence, general
provenance.notes: Copper and the name Alashiya are attested; the identification of Alashiya with Cyprus is widely accepted but not universally settled.
